models.name: 3PL IRT item parameters (PYQs)
models.parameters_come_from: hand-designed formula: per-tier base values plus constant adjustments for time, text length, explanation steps, diagram and question type
limitations: no response data exists to fit them
the time input is itself derived from the tier, so the chain is circular
formula tiers agree with human tiers at kappa 0.07

models.name: IRT ability estimate (EAP)
models.parameters_come_from: Bayesian posterior under the item parameters above and a N(0,1) prior
limitations: calibration holds only for simulated students drawn from the same parameters
no real student has been scored against a ground truth

models.name: Cold-start ridge (new items)
models.job: a, b, c for unseen questions
models.parameters_come_from: ridge regression on targets that are derived from the question features
limitations: R-squared is high because targets are computed from the inputs

models.name: Bayesian Knowledge Tracing
models.parameters_come_from: hand-set guess, slip, transit and half-life constants per tier; p_init from a hand-written mixture clipped to 0.22-0.54
limitations: real EM trainer is built but skipped until 200 students exist

models.name: DINA skill diagnosis
models.parameters_come_from: regex keyword rules decide which skills a question needs (unvalidated Q-matrix)
limitations: excluded from real training because the Q-matrix is not validated

models.name: LinUCB question picker
models.parameters_come_from: reward is a design objective (0.65 ZPD alignment + 0.35 Fisher information); warm start from a synthetic reward
limitations: regret is measured on the simulated reward, not on student learning
A/B test against random needs 100 students per arm

models.name: Difficulty random forest (production)
limitations: accuracy measures how well the formula is re-learned, not real difficulty

models.name: Difficulty v2.1 (candidate)
models.parameters_come_from: TF-IDF + logistic regression on content-team tiers, 5-fold split by paper
limitations: trained on sample papers; domain shift to PYQs is unmeasured
how the human tiers were produced is not visible to the ML side
not promoted: needs the blind human review

models.name: Temperature calibration
models.parameters_come_from: fitted then rejected on the untouched holdout
limitations: not in use

models.name: NCERT retriever (TF-IDF + SVD)
models.parameters_come_from: TF-IDF and 32-dimensional SVD over NCERT notes and PYQs
limitations: measures chapter retrieval, not tutoring quality
semantic challenger is on HOLD

models.name: Chapter resolver
models.parameters_come_from: TF-IDF + logistic regression; acts only at >= 90% held-out precision
limitations: low coverage: most generic labels stay quarantined

models.name: Near-duplicate guard
models.parameters_come_from: TF-IDF cosine with a chosen threshold
limitations: no labeled accuracy measured

models.name: Monte Carlo score simulator
models.parameters_come_from: posterior predictive on the equated reference form
limitations: no real NEET scores exist to validate against

models.name: Score-to-percentile-to-AIR curve
models.parameters_come_from: hand-set anchors; only candidate counts and cut-offs are sourced
limitations: NTA publishes no full score-percentile table
facts were not re-verified in the audit

models.name: Equated 180-question forms
models.parameters_come_from: item swaps to match information curves
limitations: equality holds under the model's own parameters, not proven on students

models.name: Study plan, importance, leverage, drift limits
models.parameters_come_from: rules, heuristic weights and chosen thresholds
limitations: no outcome data to validate against

models.name: Student-response training (IRT MML-EM, BKT EM)

simulated_self_test.label: SIMULATED data, used only to verify the estimation code; not a model result

limitations: self-test uses simulated students only

models.name: AIR estimator
models.parameters_come_from: composes the items above with the sourced cut-offs
limitations: calibration is on simulated students
range widens when label and year assumptions are varied

models.name: Text-quality gate
models.parameters_come_from: character ranges and exact duplicate options
limitations: not measured against labeled corruption
